turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I need a new duvet and every packet has a number called a tog. What does that even mean?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Tog is just a warmth rating. Low numbers are light and cool, high numbers are thick and toasty.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My bedroom is freezing in winter but like a sauna in summer.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then look at all seasons duvets. They come as two layers that clip together, a light one and a medium one, so you use one or both.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, that's clever. Are feather ones better than the synthetic ones?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Feather and down are lighter for the same warmth and breathe nicely. Synthetic is cheaper, easier to wash, and better if you have allergies.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good call. Look for one labelled hypoallergenic and check it fits in your washing machine, or you'll be off to the launderette.
